about_the_game:
Tic Tac Rogue is an indie roguelite game where classic DnD mechanics meet tactical grid combat. Play adventure mode and discover classic foes brought to life in a cute and funny pixel art style. Roll a D20 to attack, and place your moves on a tic-tac-toe board. Choose from three iconic classes and dive into an adventure filled with dice rolls, tactical placement, and evolving gear. Defeat waves of goblins and orcs, earn gold, and unlock unique magic items that reshape your strategy with every run.

Features:

  • Choose from one of 3 classes available at launch, with more on the way.

  • Roll a D20 to beat enemy AC and claim your spot on the board.

  • Battle through escalating fights against goblins, orcs, and other classic foes.

  • Discover, loot, or buy Magic Items that give unique abilities.

  • Endless Mode: Unlock infinite battles after beating the boss - how long can you survive?

Classic mode

  • Need a break from dice rolls and dungeon crawls? Classic Mode lets you play traditional tic-tac-toe with a friend (local 2-player) or against the AI - no magic items, just pure grid mastery.

Early Access

  • Tic Tac Rogue is launching in Early Access to grow with its players. Your feedback will help shape new classes, items, enemies, and more. The core loop is already playable and polished - now it’s time to expand the world together.

About the developer

  • Created entirely by a solo developer, Tic Tac Rogue is a labor of love built from scratch with 100% NO AI-generated assets.

Choose a class, battle silly pixel-art goblins and orcs, earn gold, and unlock magic items that reshape your strategy. Roll a D20 to attack and claim the board - every square is a chance to strike or survive.
